BAD SERVICE AND KIND OF CHEAT
Jun 2023 • Family
We booked a table for 5 people at 3.15 pm and the staff adviced us should take time to enjoy food as at 4pm they reset the buffet for dinner choices and there are more food to choose. 
We were happy to pick up food left from lunch set and at 4pm the kitchen team refesh buffet with hot and great selections of new arrival. But when they realized that only my family of 5 were there they talked to eachother in Vietnamese that “should not refill more and bring food back to kitchen”, that was so disappointed and we felt that we were cheated by the restaurant, and my oldest son He
Could understand all that and reported me and my wife. Then my wife checked all prawns, salmons and others were empty. She called me to see and took the pictures (as posted) and I asked the manager the reason why they could do that??? He appologized and asked team refill and setup again but for me who is hotel manager I understand how they worked and stop eating, we left the restaurant with the worst experience in the buffet place. 
I can not recommend this restaurant to anyone and think the owner should work with the team and be fair with customers and never cheat any one like us if they want to continue this business!

SeoYool92
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam718 contributions

Nice buffet on weekdays!
Mar 2020
2nd time had buffet this brand. D'Maris is quite famous recently about the food diversity. Good food, plenty of areas, 2 dishes you shouldn't leave is beefsteak shrimp. They may have their private recipes.
Love the dessert area the most, nice & luxury decor with plenty of choices. Had pudding last time so choose tart, cheesecake, maccaron... this time. Mashmallow is good also and not too sweet. Didnot drink cappu, americano, espresso... (too dark). Trendy restaurant in Corona season with orange juice, red 
dragon fruit juice, coconut juice, honey passion juice...
Should eat as order: appetizers - sushi, kimbap, fried food... Main dishes: pizza (can eat at other restaurants), shrimp, beefsteak (with add-on in front off the kitchen bar), salad (going to try beef salad but choose the wrong peanut salad @@)... Few of seafood but too fresh to eat, spicey sentinel crabs but too fresh. Vietnamese food areas has few customers. Same to BBQ & Korean chachang myeon. Can find chocolate ball at the dessert area. Stew egg was good but should try at last. 
Get 15% discount voucher this month. Staffs at beefsteak is funny and nice enough. 
Friday lunch buffet was too crowded :)) 2 people pay approx 700.000 VND.
Minus point: booked for days but cannot have the seats with good view. Have to sit middle of the crowd.

Decent buffet value and service, but flavors missing
Jun 2018 • Friends
I've been to D'Maris in District 2 before and thought it was both delicious and a very good value for the price of 500,000 VND, so I also came out to the Cong Hoa location by the airport with high expectations.

The hostess staff that greets you is quite friendly, as are the servers who serve water and clean up your plates. My favorite dish is pie crust soup, and it was just as good during this visit. The made-to-order pasta is also decent, but pass on the made-to-order steak. Everything else, however, including BBQ, Korean, Chinese, and Sushi just wasn't up to par this time around. It was all a bit more bland and tasted like it had been sitting out for quite a long time.

I guess the bright side was I actually left a buffet and didn't have a food coma for once!
